passive.name: Hextech Capacitor
passive.text: When Jayce swaps weapons he gains Move Speed for a short duration.

spells.name: To the Skies! / Shock Blast
spells.text: Hammer Stance: Leaps to an enemy dealing physical damage and slowing enemies.Cannon Stance: Fires an orb of electricity that detonates upon hitting an enemy (or reaching the end of its path) dealing physical damage to all enemies hit.

spells.name: Lightning Field / Hyper Charge
spells.text: Hammer Stance: Passive: Restores Mana per strike. Active: Creates a field of lightning damaging nearby enemies for several seconds.Cannon Stance: Gains a burst of energy, increasing Attack Speed to maximum for several attacks.

spells.name: Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate
spells.text: Hammer Stance: Deals magic damage to an enemy and knocks them back a short distance.Cannon Stance: Deploys an Acceleration Gate increasing the Move Speed of all allied champions who pass through it. If Shock Blast is fired through the gate the missile speed, range, and damage will increase.

spells.name: Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer
spells.text: Hammer Stance: Transforms the Mercury Hammer into the Mercury Cannon gaining new abilities and increased range. The first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist.Cannon Stance: Transforms the Mercury Cannon into the Mercury Hammer gaining new abilities and increasing Armor and Magic Resist. The first attack in this form deals additional magic damage.

damage.value: Jayce deals physical damage with To the Skies and Shock Blast and magic damage with Thundering Blow.

archetype.value: Jayce is a stance-switching fighter who alternates ranged attacks with melee abilities.

axis.value: Jayce plays for push control and accurate Q poke.

winCondition.value: Jayce wins lane decisively, builds side-lane pressure, and closes games before falling off late.

spikes.why: Jayce can fire Shock Blast through it for greater missile speed, range, and damage.

mistakes.value: Jayce loses push control by throwing Q randomly and missing spells.
Jayce misses Shock Blast’s extra speed, range, and damage when he fires it without sending it through Acceleration Gate.
